title: Opening the engineering notebook
text: Added six engineering guides covering architecture, persistent memory, autonomous research, tools, media and operations.

title: A fuller public record
text: Expanded the project overview with memory, autonomous work selection, research and server integration. Added Horatio’s 2023 origins and an invitation to meet him in The Jazz Cafe.

title: Separating image and text budgets
text: Traced the media-budget failure to encoded image data being counted as conversation text. Separated visual and text allowances to preserve room for reasoning and responses.

title: Less duplication in backups
text: Reduced redundant copies of application data in the backup workflow. Organized release history and staging checkpoints for easier change tracking.

title: Checking autonomous follow-through
text: Focused development on research completion, corrections and tool reuse, with closer attention to queues, retries and repeated work.
